resources.string: Hold a wake lock and Wi-Fi lock while a session is running, so servers keep answering with the screen off.
Restart the sessions that were running when the device shut down.
Listen on port 2022 on every interface instead of only this device. Use with SSH keys.
Public keys allowed to log in, one per line.
Paste public keys (ssh-ed25519 …, ssh-rsa …), one per line. They are added to the default user\'s ~/.ssh/authorized_keys each time a session starts.
Offer graphical desktops (XFCE, LXDE) over VNC and show GUI-only apps. Off by default: AndLin sessions are SSH terminals.
Desktop sessions are turned off. Enable them under Settings → Desktop (VNC).
This filesystem runs in a virtual machine, which this device or build doesn\'t support.
The virtual machine didn\'t confirm it stopped.
Let Android keep AndLin running in the background. Needed on many devices for servers to stay up.
AndLin is already exempt from battery optimization.
Turn off Android 12+\'s phantom process killer through Wireless debugging.
